formulaPanelSettingsAutoFocusDesc: Choose where the focus goes when the formula panel opens.
formulaPanelSettingsShowVirtualKeyboardT: Control whether the MathLive virtual keyboard button is visible.
formulaPanelSettingsManualVirtualKeyboar: When enabled, the virtual keyboard must be closed by clicking the toggle button. When disabled, it will automatically close when clicking outside the editor.
formulaPanelSettingsVirtualKeyboardPlace: Control where the virtual keyboard is mounted relative to the editor.
formulaPanelSettingsShowMenuToggleDesc: Control whether the MathLive menu button is visible.
formulaPanelSettingsTextareaModeDesc: Control whether the native textarea remains visible.
formulaPanelSettingsEditorFontSizeDesc: Value in px. The editor height adapts with it.
formulaPanelSettingsEditorPaddingBlockDe: Value in px. Applied to both the editor and textarea.
formulaPanelSettingsEditorPaddingInlineD: Value in px. Applied to both the editor and textarea.
